🎬 Genera+ion (2021)

Genera+ion follows a diverse group of high school students navigating the complicated realities of growing up in modern America while exploring their identities, relationships, and personal struggles. Set in a conservative California community, the series centers on teenagers whose experiences with friendship, sexuality, family expectations, and social pressure challenge traditional ideas about adolescence. Among them is Chester, a confident and outspoken student whose bold personality often hides deeper emotional vulnerabilities, and siblings Nathan and Naomi, whose complicated relationships and personal discoveries create tension within their family. Meanwhile, Greta, Riley, and their classmates experience unexpected romances, heartbreaks, misunderstandings, and difficult conversations that shape their understanding of themselves and one another. As the teenagers confront questions about identity, acceptance, love, and belonging, they must also navigate the expectations of parents, teachers, and a society that does not always understand their experiences. Through awkward encounters, emotional revelations, rebellious decisions, and moments of unexpected humor, the series captures the uncertainty and excitement of discovering who you truly are. Combining honest storytelling, sharp comedy, emotional drama, and relatable coming-of-age experiences, Genera+ion explores friendship, self-expression, family relationships, personal growth, acceptance, and the challenges of finding your place in an ever-changing world.

🎭 Genre: Drama • Comedy • Coming-of-Age

⭐ IMDb: 7.0/10

⏱️ Runtime: Approximately 30–35 minutes per episode • TV-MA

🎥 Creators: Daniel Barnz & Zelda Barnz
